EnableHandbookPerformanceOptimizations.comment: Cached and lazy handbook filtering, faster reopen and close behavior, and related page reuse. Disable this when another mod owns handbook performance patches.

EnableCreatedByRecipeFilter.comment: Limit vanilla Created by recipe scans to likely matching grid recipes while handbook pages are composed.

EnableVariantGrouping.comment: Show one handbook row for duplicate material/geology variants while keeping the original pages searchable and linkable.

EnableModCategoryTab.comment: Add the Mods handbook tab and per-mod item/block category list.

EnableBookmarks.comment: Add bookmark storage, the Bookmarks handbook tab, and the bookmark detail-page button.

EnableLockedPage.comment: Add the locked-page detail button and reopen the locked handbook page automatically.

EnableAutoFillButton.comment: Add the handbook Auto-Fill button for craftable items.

EnableUsesButton.comment: Add the handbook Uses button for opening recipe-use lookup from an item page.

EnableUsesHotkey.comment: Register the U hotkey for opening recipe-use lookup from the hovered item.

EnableRecipeOverlays.comment: Show recipe helper overlays, tool durability markings, max stack size info, and failed Auto-Fill highlights.

EnableSlideshowScroll.comment: Allow mouse-wheel control of handbook item and recipe slideshow components.

EnableCraftingOutputConflictScroll.comment: Allow mouse-wheel selection of alternate crafting-grid outputs when several recipes match the same inputs. Disabled by default because it patches server-side crafting behavior.

EnableGenericContainerDropFix.comment: Skip unsafe handbook drop previews for generic typed containers that have no stored type.

ShowAutoFillMessages.comment: Show chat messages when Auto-Fill succeeds or fails.

EnableInfoLogging.comment: Log one-time BetterHandbook startup and index summary messages.

EnableDiagnosticLogging.comment: Log detailed recipe, button, and Auto-Fill diagnostics. This is very noisy.

EnableAutoFillTraceLogging.comment: Log every step of shift-left-click Auto-Fill. Only enable while reproducing Auto-Fill bugs.

EnableFailureLogging.comment: Log recoverable warnings. Errors are always logged.

MaxAutoCloseSeconds.comment: Upper bound for the auto-close delay a player can pick on a door. A limit, not a default — every door behaviour in this mod is opt-in per block.

MaxAutoOpenRange.comment: Upper bound for the auto-open trigger radius a player can pick.

MaxSwingSeconds.comment: Slowest swing a player can ask for; also the GUI slider maximum.

CollisionFollowsAnimationAboveSeconds.comment: Doors that take longer than this to swing keep their collision boxes shut until the animation finishes, so a slow castle gate is genuinely blocked while still opening. Quicker doors keep the stock instant behaviour. 0 turns the feature off.

MinSwingSeconds.comment: Fastest swing a player can ask for.

TickIntervalMs.comment: How often the server checks auto-close timers and auto-open proximity. Takes effect on next world load — the tick loop is registered at startup.

MaxEditDistance.comment: How far a player may be from a door and still edit it. Purely an anti-tamper bound; land claims and locks decide actual permission.

EaseFullSeconds.comment: Seconds an engine easing animation of speed 1.0 takes to effectively finish; converts between the seconds a player picks and engine speed. Raise it if slow doors visually lag behind their collision.

{
  "version": 1,
  "file": "fastmap.json",
  "patches": {},
  "settings": [
    {
      "type": "separator",
      "title": "Cache"
    },
    {
      "code": "PageTextureBudget",
      "type": "integer",
      "default": 512,
      "clientSide": true,
      "ingui": "Page texture budget",
      "comment": "Maximum number of cached map page textures kept in GPU memory before old off-screen pages are evicted.",
      "range": {
        "min": 16,
        "max": 10000,
        "step": 16
      }
    },
    {
      "code": "PageMemoryBudget",
      "type": "integer",
      "default": 1024,
      "clientSide": true,
      "ingui": "Page memory budget",
      "comment": "Maximum number of FastMap page components kept in RAM after GPU textures are evicted. Higher values make pan-back faster at the cost of memory.",
      "range": {
        "min": 16,
        "max": 20000,
        "step": 16
      }
    },
    {
      "code": "ReadyPageQueueBudget",
      "type": "integer",
      "default": 64,
      "clientSide": true,
      "ingui": "Ready page queue budget",
      "comment": "Maximum number of loaded/generated page snapshots allowed to wait for main-thread upload. Keeps fallback generation from outrunning uploads and hoarding RAM.",
      "range": {
        "min": 4,
        "max": 512,
        "step": 4
      }
    },
    {
      "code": "EnableTextureAtlas",
      "type": "boolean",
      "default": true,
      "clientSide": true,
      "ingui": "Use texture atlases",
      "comment": "Group uploaded map pages into larger GPU atlas textures. This reduces texture object churn and can improve large-map loading and panning."
    },
    {
      "code": "EnableCompressedCache",
      "type": "boolean",
      "default": true,
      "clientSide": true,
      "ingui": "Use compressed disk cache",
      "comment": "Write sparse LZ4-compressed cache files. Disable to write the older raw pages-v1 format."
    },
    {
      "code": "UseFilteredCache",
      "type": "boolean",
      "default": false,
      "clientSide": true,
      "ingui": "Use experimental filtered cache",
      "comment": "Write pages-v3 cache files using a channel-shuffle filter before LZ4 compression. This may reduce cache size for some worlds, but can increase it significantly depending on map data."
    },
    {
      "code": "UseHighCompressionCache",
      "type": "boolean",
      "default": false,
      "clientSide": true,
      "ingui": "Use LZ4HC cache writes",
      "comment": "Write compressed cache files with LZ4 high compression. This can reduce disk usage further, but costs more CPU while saving pages."
    },
    {
      "code": "CleanupKeepLatestPageVersion",
      "type": "boolean",
      "default": true,
      "clientSide": true,
      "ingui": "Cleanup keeps latest page version",
      "comment": "When running .fastmap cleanupcache, keep the newest pages-vN folder in each world cache and delete only older page-version folders."
    },
    {
      "code": "EnableVanillaMapDbWriteback",
      "type": "boolean",
      "default": true,
      "clientSide": true,
      "ingui": "Write vanilla map DB",
      "comment": "Also write generated FastMap terrain tiles back to Vintage Story's vanilla map database so the vanilla map remains useful if FastMap is removed or needs to rebuild."
    },
    {
      "code": "CleanupStaleVanillaMapDbSidecarsOnStartup",
      "type": "boolean",
      "default": true,

PageTextureBudget.comment: Maximum number of cached map page textures kept in GPU memory before old off-screen pages are evicted.

PageMemoryBudget.comment: Maximum number of FastMap page components kept in RAM after GPU textures are evicted. Higher values make pan-back faster at the cost of memory.

ReadyPageQueueBudget.comment: Maximum number of loaded/generated page snapshots allowed to wait for main-thread upload. Keeps fallback generation from outrunning uploads and hoarding RAM.

EnableTextureAtlas.comment: Group uploaded map pages into larger GPU atlas textures. This reduces texture object churn and can improve large-map loading and panning.

EnableCompressedCache.comment: Write sparse LZ4-compressed cache files. Disable to write the older raw pages-v1 format.

UseFilteredCache.comment: Write pages-v3 cache files using a channel-shuffle filter before LZ4 compression. This may reduce cache size for some worlds, but can increase it significantly depending on map data.

UseHighCompressionCache.comment: Write compressed cache files with LZ4 high compression. This can reduce disk usage further, but costs more CPU while saving pages.

CleanupKeepLatestPageVersion.comment: When running .fastmap cleanupcache, keep the newest pages-vN folder in each world cache and delete only older page-version folders.

EnableVanillaMapDbWriteback.comment: Also write generated FastMap terrain tiles back to Vintage Story's vanilla map database so the vanilla map remains useful if FastMap is removed or needs to rebuild.

CleanupStaleVanillaMapDbSidecarsOnStartu.comment: Delete stale <world>.db-wal and <world>.db-shm files once on startup before FastMap opens the vanilla map database.

TerrainSamplerFallbackResolutionScale.comment: Synthetic terrain-sampler map resolution. 1 stores and samples every pixel; 4 stores one pixel per 4x4 page area; larger values are faster and smaller.

EnableTerrainSamplerFallbackTrueColor.comment: When true-colour world maps are enabled, use sparse loaded-surface block colour probes to improve synthetic terrain-sampler fallback pages without sampling every pixel.

TerrainSamplerFallbackTrueColorProbeStri.comment: Sparse fallback true-colour probe spacing in low-resolution fallback cells. 4 means one loaded-surface colour probe per 4x4 fallback cells.

seafarer.contents:
version: 1


##################
## Drying Frame ##
##################


# Enable rain-based spoilage acceleration on drying frames
drying-enable-rain-rot: false
 #  (default: True) 

# Enable wind-based drying acceleration on drying frames
drying-enable-wind: false
 #  (default: True) 

# Max perish speed multiplier during heavy rain
drying-rain-rot-multiplier: 2.25
 # from 1 to 10 with step of 0.5 (default: 2) 

# Wind drying bonus multiplier (higher = faster drying in wind)
drying-wind-multiplier: 30.25
 # from 1 to 100 with step of 1 (default: 30) 

# Base drying speed multiplier on the rack
drying-speed-multiplier: 10.25
 # from 1 to 50 with step of 1 (default: 10) 

# Rainfall level (0-1) above which rain rot activates
drying-rain-threshold: 0.3
 # from 0 to 1 with step of 0.05 (default: 0.05) 


##############
## Salt Pan ##
##############


# Master toggle for salt pan evaporation
saltpan-enabled: false
 #  (default: True) 

# Maximum litres of saltwater the pan holds
saltpan-capacity: 10.25
 # from 1 to 50 with step of 1 (default: 10) 

# Base evaporation rate in litres per hour at 20C
saltpan-evap-rate: 0.458
 # from 0.01 to 2 with step of 0.01 (default: 0.208) 

# Salt items yielded per litre of saltwater evaporated
saltpan-salt-yield: 0.65
 # from 0.1 to 5 with step of 0.1 (default: 0.4) 

# Minimum temperature (C) for evaporation to occur
saltpan-min-temp: 0.25
 # from -20 to 30 with step of 1 (default: 0) 

# Maximum temperature multiplier cap for evaporation
saltpan-max-temp-mult: 2.25
 # from 1 to 5 with step of 0.25 (default: 2) 


####################
## Griddle Hearth ##
####################


# Cook speed multiplier for clay griddle
griddle-speed-clay: 1.25
 # from 0.5 to 5 with step of 0.25 (default: 1) 

# Cook speed multiplier for copper griddle
griddle-speed-copper: 1.75
 # from 0.5 to 5 with step of 0.25 (default: 1.5) 

# Cook speed multiplier for bronze griddle
griddle-speed-bronze: 2
 # from 0.5 to 5 with step of 0.25 (default: 1.75) 

# Cook speed multiplier for iron griddle
griddle-speed-iron: 2.25
 # from 0.5 to 5 with step of 0.25 (default: 2) 

# Cook speed multiplier for steel griddle
griddle-speed-steel: 2.25
 # from 0.5 to 5 with step of 0.25 (default: 2) 


###########
## Boats ##
###########


# Speed multiplier for the log barge (takes effect on next boat spawn / world load)
logbarge-speed-multiplier: 1.15
 # from 0.1 to 5 with step of 0.1 (default: 0.9) 

# Speed multiplier for the outrigger (takes effect on next boat spawn / world load)
outrigger-speed-multiplier: 2.25
 # from 0.1 to 5 with step of 0.1 (default: 2) 


######################
## Story Structures ##
######################


# Generate the Tortuga story structure (takes effect for newly generated chunks only)
structure-tortuga: false
 #  (default: True) 

# Generate the Potato King's House story structure (takes effect for newly generated chunks only)
structure-potatoking: false
 #  (default: True) 

# Generate the Wreck of the Crimson Rose story structure (takes effect for newly generated chunks only)
structure-wreck-crimsonrose: false
 #  (default: True) 

# Generate the Abandoned Farm story structure (takes effect for newly generated chunks only)
structure-abandoned-farm: false
 #  (default: True) 


##############
## Mud Rake ##
##############


# Number of times the drop table is rolled per block broken with a mud rake
mudrake-drop-rolls: 1.25
 # from 1 to 10 with step of 1 (default: 1)
